name: provider-failure-cause
title: A failed provider call records why, and the reading carries it
description: The message_end handler wrote the provider record and classified the failure afterwards, so every errored record held stopReason error with no cause: six across every ledger on this machine, none naming why, one after a five-minute round. Classify first, record the kind and reason, and carry them into the failure reading.
creator: aixi
